logline: After a humble waiter sacrifices everything to support his ungrateful girlfriend only to be disowned and cheated on, he transforms into a wealthy mogul three years later and coldly rejects her desperate attempt to win him back.

hook.mechanic: Within the first 2 seconds, a girl publicly disowns her waiter boyfriend at a high-end restaurant to avoid embarrassment, instantly creating conflict and outrage.
hook.first_line: Isn't that your boyfriend? No, he just works here. Seriously? Not here.

moment: The ungrateful ex-girlfriend realizes her huge mistake and tries to play dumb and hug him, but Nate coldly calls out her lies and rejects her, leaving her with nothing.

beats.what_happens: A snobby friend points out the waiter at a high-end restaurant, and the girlfriend embarrassed disowns him on the spot.
Flashback reveals the waiter previously saved her from financial ruin by giving her his hard-earned money.
Shots of him scrubbing filthy restaurant floors to earn a thick stack of cash, which he hands directly to her.
She tearfully embraces him, claiming they both win when his sacrifice works.
After serving her table, he walks outside into the rain only to see her getting into a sports car with another man.
A text card signals a three-year jump into the future.
The cheating boyfriend brings the girl to a penthouse meeting with Nate, who is now a wealthy mogul in designer clothes. She pretends she doesn't know Nate.

She tries to hug him affectionately, but Nate coldly exposes her lie ('Never met him, huh?') and dismisses her permanently.

lines.text: Isn't that your boyfriend? No, he just works here. Seriously? Not here.
I paid for it. I'm gonna lose everything! No you're not.
You did this for me? For us.
When this works, we both win! Can you please not do this?
Nate, thanks for meeting us. This is my girlfriend. Nice to meet you. You good? Yeah, I've never met him. One sec.
I was stupid. What about him? He was supposed to be the upgrade.
Never met him, huh? It's not what it looks like. It is. And us? Us? That's out of here.
